item.title: Pre-order “Death Is Certain, Life Is Not” on vinyl
item.description: VINYL LOVERS! We are releasing our album from 2012 on vinyl soon. Please go to our Kickstarter campaign and pre-order before may 1st. The album contains an extended version of "The Fallen Ones" aswell as the CD with the bonus track "I Am Your God". Click here to pre-order!

item.title: Spain tour 2019
item.description: SPAIN, WE ARE COMING BACK! We are very excited and happy to announce a tour in Spain in september. Make sure to check out the tour schedule and get tickets fast! It's gonna be sold out! Check out the schedule now!

item.title: “Circle” to be released on vinyl!
item.description: Pre-order now! Our former album "Circle" is being released on vinyl finally! Blue transparent vinyl with a nice gatefold cover. Check out our nice bundles in the webshop and pre-order your copy now! Webshop

item.title: We are still alive!!!!
item.description: After years of silence, SPARZANZA will be back. First of is a set of two singles recorded earlier this year. We know it´s been a while, thanks for your patience! As a proof we give you a shot from the video recording of the first single. Keep yourself updated on our Facebook page or our Instagram.

item.title: Finland tour 2025
item.description: Finally, we know you have waited a long time and we´d like to thank you for being patient. But now it´s time, our first tour in Finland since 2019. We really hope to see you there! Tickets out friday may 30th, click the links for more info. 8/10/25 - Tampere, Tavara-Asema 9/10/25 - Jyväskyla, Lutakko 10/10/25 - Helsinki, On the Rocks 11/10/25 - Turku, Apollo
